hero.title:
Know where
your money goes.
hero.lede: Jotly logs an expense in about three seconds — double-tap the back of your iPhone, type the amount, pick a category. Dram, dollars or euros, all in one place.
how.title: Faster than forgetting.
how.s1.p: A one-minute setup in Jotly links a double-tap on the back of your iPhone to a new jot.
how.s2.p: Paid for coffee? Double-tap — the jot sheet opens over whatever you were doing, even from the lock screen.
how.s3.p: Type the amount in any currency, tap a category, save. About three seconds, start to finish.
feat.title: Everything you need to know where it went.
feat.lede: No bank logins, no spreadsheets. Just your jots, turned into clear numbers.
feat.1.p: One sheet for amount, note and category. Your default account and category are already picked.
feat.2.p: Jot in dram, dollars, euros or rubles. Totals convert to your main currency at that day's rate.
feat.3.p: Set a monthly budget and per-category limits. See what's left per day, and which category ran over.
feat.4.p: Income versus spending by month, what you kept, and plain-language notes on what changed.
feat.5.p: Your jots live on your iPhone and sync through your own iCloud. Lock the app with Face ID.
feat.6.p: Follows your iPhone's appearance. Available in English, Russian, Spanish, Armenian, Turkish and French.
screens.title: See where it went.
screens.lede: Activity, category split and monthly insights — all from the jots you already made.
price.title: One plan. First month on us.
price.lede: Try everything free for a month. Keep going for less than one coffee — cancel anytime in your App Store settings.
faq.title: Questions
faq.1.q: Does Jotly connect to my bank?
faq.1.a: No. You jot what you spend, so nothing needs your bank login. Automatic jots from Apple Wallet payments are coming soon.
faq.2.a: On your iPhone, synced through your own iCloud account. You can export everything to CSV at any time.
faq.3.a: Jot in any currency. Pick a main currency for totals and budgets; each jot keeps its original amount and the rate from that day.
faq.4.a: Jotly is iPhone-only for now. It's available in English, Russian, Spanish, Armenian, Turkish and French.
final.title: Your next coffee is a three-second jot.
meta.title: Jotly — Quick Expense Tracker for iPhone
meta.description: Jotly logs an expense in about three seconds. Double-tap the back of your iPhone, type the amount, pick a category. Multi-currency, budgets and insights.
